name: Kőszegszerdahely (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, light grey at the hoist and red at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kőszegszerdahely: a red and white shield with three towers, a bunch of grapes and a green mound.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
